title: Saltmere, a fishing village
changes: Saltmere has grown into a real fishing village: The Gull & Anchor tavern, a chandlery, a smokehouse, new cottages, boats at the piers, gulls and the sound of the sea, and fisherfolk who mend nets by day and go home at dusk.
Its cobbled harbour square is a safe zone with a stash chest. Once you have woken Saltmere's waystone, you wake there after dying in the south of Act 1.
Meet Bess, Hob, Marta and Agna: Hob sells flasks and fuses runes, and Bess has two new quests (Lv 16-17).
After the Redfang chain, Pell's boat carries you between Saltmere, Gullrock Cove and Heronwreck Strand for 12 gold.
